# The ZAO

> The ZAO (ZTalent Artist Organization) is a decentralized impact network that brings the profit margin, data, and IP rights back to artists using emerging technology like blockchain and AI. Priority stack: music first, community second, technology third. Founded by Zaal Panthaki (BetterCallZaal).

The ZAO is not a record label or a "music community." It is an impact network whose first artist domain is music. Technology is the means, not the headline. The acronym ZAO = ZTalent Artist Organization (etymology); the descriptor for what it is today is a decentralized impact network - both are correct.

## What The ZAO returns to artists
- Profit margin
- Data
- IP rights

## Governance - the Fractal and Respect
- Respect is the on-chain contribution currency: a soulbound OG ERC-20 plus a ZOR ERC-1155, both on Optimism.
- A weekly Respect Game ranks contributions; rewards follow a Fibonacci curve. It has run 100+ unbroken weeks (since 2024-07-30).
- On-chain execution via OREC (Optimistic Respect Execution Contract): a 72-hour voting window plus a 72-hour veto window.
- Verified on-chain (2026-07-05): 156 unique Respect holders (122 OG + 55 ZOR, 21 hold both); OG distribution Gini roughly 0.73.

## Legal / entity
- The ZAO has no formal legal entity yet; the operating umbrella is BetterCallZaal Strategies LLC. Some lanes spin out their own entities as they mature.

## Production lanes
- WaveWarZ - live-traded music battles (Solana mainnet + Base testnet)
- ZABAL Games - the 3-month build-a-thon
- The ZAO festivals - ZAOstock, ZAOville, ZAO-PALOOZA, ZAO-CHELLA
- ZAO OS - the lab/monorepo where new ZAO things prototype before graduating to their own repo and domain
